features.details: Classical methodology (Thiên Lương – Thái Thứ Lang) with mandatory 3-step structural analysis and 12-palace logic.

patterns: Use Table Lookup for Lunar Date to avoid algorithmic complexity/drift
Avoid java.time in core logic if MinSDK < 26 to skip desugaring
Calculate scores before appending modifiers like (M)/(V) to star names
Use startsWith() for Tứ Hóa lookup to support modified star names
gotchas: Palace Direction: Mệnh -> Phụ -> Phúc is THUẬN (+1 index) in Nam Phai standards.
Thiên Phủ Symmetry: Symmetry sum must be 4 (Dần axis), formula is (4 - tuViPos) % 12.
Star Naming: Some stars (like Văn Khúc) have different placement rules based on Can vs Chi; always use the correct Map.
